```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: replacement for the deck slide "Cell-type proportions shift
modestly, in different directions at each stage" - a two-panel figure:

- Panel A: the original 5 broad cell-type stacked bar (% of total cells
  per sample), unchanged in content from the current deck slide.
- Panel B: Endocardium and Mesenchyme subtype composition (Sophie's marker
  gene sets, corrected this session - no more "Endocardium_unclassified",
  Endocardium properly labelled rather than grey "other"), each bar % of
  that parent cell type specifically, same 4-sample x-axis as Panel A.

Panel B uses a different colour palette entirely from Panel A so nothing
looks like it means the same thing across the two panels (the source
Python scripts' subtype colours happen to reuse some of the same hex
values as the main cell-type palette for unrelated categories).

**Standalone script** - reads already-saved objects/outputs, does not
modify any existing script.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
main_data_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "06-cluster_marker_genes")
subtype_csv_path <- file.path(
  project_repo_dir, "outDir", "14-rna_velocity", "endocardial_mesenchymal_egfp",
  "subtype_proportions_bootstrap", "all_samples_subtype_metadata.csv"
)
out_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "16-lab_meeting_deck", "celltype_subtype_composition")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

sample_labels <- c(
  "e11_control" = "E11.5 Ctrl",
  "e11_ko"      = "E11.5 KO",
  "e12_control" = "E12.5 Ctrl",
  "e12_ko"      = "E12.5 KO"
)
sample_order <- names(sample_labels)
```

# Panel A: broad cell-type composition (5 types, % of total cells per sample)

```{r panel-a-data}
re_embed_interesting_cells <- readRDS(file.path(main_data_dir, "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(re_embed_interesting_cells, "Seurat"))

celltype_cols <- c(
  "Myocardium"  = "#E41A1C",
  "VSMC"        = "#984EA3",
  "Epicardium"  = "#FF7F00",
  "Mesenchyme"  = "#4DAF4A",
  "Endocardium" = "#377EB8"
)

panel_a_data <- re_embed_interesting_cells@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(orig.ident, new_celltypes, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_labels[orig.ident], levels = sample_labels[sample_order]),
    new_celltypes = factor(new_celltypes, levels = names(celltype_cols))
  )

panel_a_data
```

```{r panel-a-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
p_panel_a <- ggplot(panel_a_data, aes(x = sample_label, y = pct, fill = new_celltypes)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct), "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Cell type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "% of cells per sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

p_panel_a
```

# Panel B: Endocardium and Mesenchyme subtype composition

```{r panel-b-data}
subtype_meta <- read_csv(subtype_csv_path) %>%
  dplyr::rename(barcode = `...1`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_labels[orig.ident], levels = sample_labels[sample_order])
  )

endocardial_order <- c("Ventricular", "Angiogenic", "Valve", "Arterial")
endocardial_cols <- c(
  "Ventricular" = "#66C2A5",
  "Angiogenic"  = "#FC8D62",
  "Valve"       = "#8DA0CB",
  "Arterial"    = "#E78AC3"
)

mesenchyme_order <- c(
  "EndoMT_derived", "EndoMT_derived (proliferating)",
  "E11_NCC", "E11_NCC (proliferating)",
  "E12_NCC_Vegfa", "E12_NCC_Sema3c"
)
mesenchyme_cols <- c(
  "EndoMT_derived"                  = "#1B9E77",
  "EndoMT_derived (proliferating)"  = "#D95F02",
  "E11_NCC"                         = "#7570B3",
  "E11_NCC (proliferating)"         = "#E7298A",
  "E12_NCC_Vegfa"                   = "#66A61E",
  "E12_NCC_Sema3c"                  = "#E6AB02"
)

endocardial_data <- subtype_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(new_celltypes == "Endocardium") %>%
  dplyr::count(sample_label, endocardial_subtype, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(endocardial_subtype = factor(endocardial_subtype, levels = endocardial_order))

mesenchyme_data <- subtype_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(new_celltypes == "Mesenchyme") %>%
  dplyr::count(sample_label, mesenchyme_subtype, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mesenchyme_subtype = factor(mesenchyme_subtype, levels = mesenchyme_order))

endocardial_data
mesenchyme_data
```

```{r panel-b-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
p_panel_b1 <- ggplot(endocardial_data, aes(x = sample_label, y = pct, fill = endocardial_subtype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct), "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = endocardial_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Endocardium subtypes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "% of Endocardium cells per sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

p_panel_b2 <- ggplot(mesenchyme_data, aes(x = sample_label, y = pct, fill = mesenchyme_subtype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct), "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mesenchyme_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Mesenchyme subtypes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "% of Mesenchyme cells per sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

p_panel_b <- p_panel_b1 + p_panel_b2

p_panel_b
```

# Combined figure

```{r combined-plot, fig.width=16, fig.height=7}
p_combined <- p_panel_a + p_panel_b +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.2)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Cell-type and subtype composition by sample",
    caption = "Endocardium/Mesenchyme subtypes per Sophie's marker gene sets"
  )

p_combined

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-celltype_subtype_composition_barchart.png"),
  plot = p_combined,
  width = 16,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Individual panels, saved separately

- Not thrown away - the panel plot above is kept as-is. These are the same
  three plots (`p_panel_a`, `p_panel_b1`, `p_panel_b2`) saved individually,
  in case the combined layout isn't what's wanted but the panels themselves
  are still useful.

```{r save-individual-panels}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-panel_a_celltype.png"),
  plot = p_panel_a,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-panel_b1_endocardium_subtypes.png"),
  plot = p_panel_b1,
  width = 5,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-panel_b2_mesenchyme_subtypes.png"),
  plot = p_panel_b2,
  width = 5,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# =============================================================================
# Single combined stacked bar: Myocardium/VSMC/Epicardium as-is,
# Endocardium and Mesenchyme broken down into their subtypes
# =============================================================================

- One composite cell-type/subtype label per cell: Myocardium/VSMC/Epicardium
  cells keep their broad label; Endocardium cells get their
  `endocardial_subtype`; Mesenchyme cells get their `mesenchyme_subtype`.
  Every segment here is % of the WHOLE sample (not % within a parent cell
  type, unlike Panel B above), so the bar still sums to 100%.

```{r single-stack-data}
subtype_lookup <- subtype_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, endocardial_subtype, mesenchyme_subtype)

single_stack_data <- re_embed_interesting_cells@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(subtype_lookup, by = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    composite_celltype = dplyr::case_when(
      new_celltypes == "Endocardium" ~ endocardial_subtype,
      new_celltypes == "Mesenchyme"  ~ mesenchyme_subtype,
      TRUE                           ~ as.character(new_celltypes)
    )
  )

# sanity check - every cell should have a composite label, and counts per
# sample should still total the original sample sizes
stopifnot(!anyNA(single_stack_data$composite_celltype))

composite_order <- c("Myocardium", "VSMC", "Epicardium", endocardial_order, mesenchyme_order)
composite_cols <- c(
  "Myocardium" = celltype_cols[["Myocardium"]],
  "VSMC"       = celltype_cols[["VSMC"]],
  "Epicardium" = celltype_cols[["Epicardium"]],
  endocardial_cols,
  mesenchyme_cols
)

single_stack_summary <- single_stack_data %>%
  dplyr::count(orig.ident, composite_celltype, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_labels[orig.ident], levels = sample_labels[sample_order]),
    composite_celltype = factor(composite_celltype, levels = composite_order)
  )

single_stack_summary
```

```{r single-stack-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
p_single_stack <- ggplot(single_stack_summary, aes(x = sample_label, y = pct, fill = composite_celltype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 2, paste0(round(pct), "%"), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = composite_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Cell-type proportions, with Endocardium and Mesenchyme broken into subtypes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "% of cells per sample",
    caption = "Endocardium/Mesenchyme subtypes per Sophie's marker gene sets"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

p_single_stack

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-single_stack_celltype_subtype_breakdown.png"),
  plot = p_single_stack,
  width = 10,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```
